name: True Small Shield
location: Alchemist - Exchange via Rainbow Gems (Only during Shield Hero crossover)

skillset.skill: 45s CT - Increases Target's DEF by 60%. Reduces Target's DMG Taken by 40% for 10s. Heals Target's HP by 10% of DMG Received after use for 10s.
